Question: I want to know about intraday trading? wheather it is allowed in islam or not please give with refrance[hawala]. Answer ID: 3760 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 472/581=B) If the buyer had a possession of it after purchasing then he can sell the thing in evening which he bought in the morning.
